verdict.rationale: Shortwave's 'Splits' feature explicitly divides one inbox into multiple focused inboxes by importance, each in its own tab, letting users triage in priority order rather than arrival order; the 'Bundles' grouping was independently praised by a power-user as 'top shelf.' Community evidence corroborates real-world use of this triage feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of newsletter- or calendar-invite-specific split categories, and hands-on confirmation of full priority-order triage workflow beyond vendor blog.
